newsitem.title: UK: Cuban orders dominate new sugar freight business.
newsitem.headline: Cuban orders dominate new sugar freight business.

text.p: Cuba featured heavily as a quoted origin on the sugar freight market on Tuesday as it geared up for its season of bulk shipments from the 1996/97 cane crop, shipbrokers said.
Pacol quoted for a substantial amount of Cuban tonnage -- 30,000 tonnes to Iran for 1/10 January, 25,500 to the Black Sea for 10/20 January and 13/13,650 tonnes to Portugal for 1/10 January onwards.
Nissho Iwai was also in the market for Cuban sugar, quoting for 24/25,000 tonnes to Japan for full January dates.
Czarnikow was open for 12,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from the Egyptian Red Sea to Pakistan for prompt shipment dates.
Seven Seas quoted for 13/14,000 tonnes in bags from Poland to Red Sea/Aden for mid-December.
